prompt_text: A surreal, clean, high-contrast chess environment. The ground is a giant black-and-white chessboard under a flat gray sky. Oversized glossy black and white chess pieces surround the board. A large reflective chrome sphere stands near the center as a key landmark. Bright overhead lighting.  First person view.

rubric_items.rubric_text: Does the ground remain a giant black-and-white chessboard pattern over time?
Does the sky remain flat gray over time?
Does the scene maintain bright overhead lighting throughout the video?
Does the environment keep a clean, surreal, high-contrast look throughout the video?
Does the environment maintain a black-white-gray dominant palette with chrome reflections over time?
When the large sphere near the center is visible and judgeable, does it appear reflective and chrome rather than matte or non-metallic?
When the sphere is visible and judgeable, does it read as a large object relative to nearby chess pieces and the board?
When chess pieces are visible and judgeable, are they rendered in black and white rather than other colors?
When the chess pieces are visible and judgeable, do they appear glossy rather than matte or rough?
When chess pieces are visible and judgeable, do they appear oversized relative to a normal chess scale in the scene?
